basics.name: Japheth Kimeu
basics.label: Geospatial Technical Advisor | FAO
basics.summary: I am a geospatial technical advisor with over 8 years of experience applying earth observation, GIS, and AI/ML to conservation, food security, and climate-smart agriculture across Africa. I currently serve as a Geospatial Technical Advisor at FAO and as GIS & Data Specialist at Connected Conservation Foundation, where I support decision-making across critical wildlife corridors and landscapes. My work spans spatial data systems, remote sensing, capacity development, and the translation of complex geospatial analysis into actionable insights for conservation and development stakeholders.

work.company: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
highlights: Provide geospatial and remote sensing advisory support across FAO programmes in East Africa, with a focus on climate-smart agriculture and natural resource management.
Lead spatial data management, analysis, and capacity development initiatives supporting partner institutions and government ministries.
Design and maintain web-based geospatial portals and databases, ensuring datasets are documented, current, and accessible to stakeholders.
Facilitate training and on-the-job capacity building for national staff and line ministry partners on GIS, remote sensing, and field data collection.
Produce thematic maps, technical reports, and cartographic products to support evidence-based decision-making in food security and natural resource contexts.
Coordinate with government agencies, UN partners, and NGOs to define spatial data needs and contribute to national information management frameworks.
Lead geospatial analysis and earth observation work across a portfolio of critical wildlife corridors and conservation landscapes in Africa.
Apply AI/ML and very high-resolution satellite imagery to biodiversity monitoring, habitat change detection, and invasive species mapping.
Support the Interconnected Earth programme, designing spatial frameworks for ecologically linked landscape conservation across multiple sites.
Develop capacity development programmes for conservation practitioners on GIS, remote sensing, and spatial data tools.
Collaborate with the Airbus Foundation and conservation partners on imagery access, analysis pipelines, and programme design.
Serve as lead judge on the Satellites for Biodiversity Award, evaluating innovative uses of satellite data for conservation outcomes.

work.position: Senior GIS and Remote Sensing Officer
highlights: Led development and maintenance of spatial data repositories, geo-databases, and web-based portals for data dissemination.
Designed and deployed geospatial applications and dashboards using ArcGIS, QGIS, Python, Power BI, and JavaScript.
Analysed remote sensing imagery to map land use change, wetland degradation, and drought conditions using Google Earth Engine and ENVI.
Supervised and trained staff on GIS analysis, remote sensing, and spatial data management.
Collaborated with the National Land Commission and other agencies on county land information management systems.
Developed GIS and earth observation tools for mapping environmental change, land use, biodiversity, and food security.
Collected and processed spatial data from UAV, satellite imagery, and LiDAR sources alongside field surveys.
Built image classification and analysis workflows using Python, R, and machine learning methods.
Trained staff and partners on natural resource data collection and geospatial analysis.
Collaborated with NGOs and government bodies to support natural resource management policy.
Supported spatial data acquisition, quality assessment, and conversion from CAD and raster formats into GIS.
Verified cadastral plans, subdivision schemes, and survey records for land title and lease processing.
Maintained and updated geo-databases with defined schema, topology rules, and relationship classes.
Prepared cartographic products and reports using ArcMap, QGIS, PostGIS, and AutoCAD Map 3D.
Food security mapping using AI
Crop mapping and identification using machine learning
Mapping missing maps for Crowd2Map Tanzania
